dedupe_keys.name: district heating network of netzgesellschaft dusseldorf utility plan information on registration

description: This Open.NRW entry describes the geodata of the district heating division of Netzgesellschaft Düsseldorf mbH within its network area. The data themselves are not published as open data: under the operator's terms of use and access, line information can be obtained through its online plan information service, which besides on-site information in Düsseldorf lets registered and authorised users such as planning offices and construction companies retrieve the required line data for the supply area over the internet. The entry is marked with a closed licence. Coverage is the Düsseldorf district heating network. Access requires registration and permission, and the entry states no fee. Caveats: this is a plan information service for works, not a download for analysis, so network topology for modelling would need an agreement with the operator. Simulation uses, where access is granted, are district heating network modelling and coordination of works and emergency response. Related records: data-nrw-municipal-heat-planning-data-lanuk gives open heat demand data for the same region.
